{{Conjecture|legends}}
A '''conflict''' was ensued when the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Rajivari]], founder of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and member of the first [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]], disagreeing with the policies that his fellow founders had agreed upon for the Order, turned to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|Dark side]] and launched a purge to destroy the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|Light side]]-based Jedi Order and rebuilt it from the ground with his own [[Principles of Rajivari|principles]]. The conflict was quickly ended after Rajivari failed to murder his fellow Council members and was killed instead. Despite Rajivari's death, his remaining followers barricaded themselves within his headquarters on [[Kaleth]] and put up a last stand against the Jedi Order, officially ending the conflict with the [[Siege of Kaleth|fall]] of Kaleth and death of all of Rajivari's followers.
